parsed.headline: leaky-memory: lower CPU is safe, memory must not be cut

cpu.explanation: The current request of 0.020 cores can be safely decreased to 0.010 cores. The candidate request from the formula was 0.000 cores, but it was adjusted to meet the minimum floor of 0.010 cores.

memory.explanation: The current request of 64Mi should be increased to 143Mi. An OOM kill was seen in the window, indicating that real demand exceeded what was measured. The peak working set of 124Mi is 97% of the memory limit of 128Mi and above the current request of 64Mi.

caveats: History covers about 0.4 h of the requested 3.0 h window.
